text:
You need a responsive sports betting tips website that clearly promotes free daily NFL/NBA picks, supports VIP subscriptions, and lets users review past results and contact support.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I have 7 years of experience building full-stack web apps with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

In a Staff onboarding portal, I built an internal React/NestJS/PostgreSQL system with role-based access control for healthcare staffing, helping 2,400 staff and cutting onboarding paperwork from 5 days to 1 day. In Embedded customer analytics, I built customer-specific dashboards in React/TypeScript/Node.js/PostgreSQL and delivered it 3 weeks early.

I can build the homepage, VIP membership flow, secure payments, results filtering, FAQ, and contact page with a fast, mobile-friendly design. Do you already have the tip content and subscription tiers ready, or should I help structure that too?
